title: Dutch interface foundation: nl language, split catalogues, complete-nl gate, Dutch system emails and voucher labels, driver app in Dutch, agency defaults in the driver app
goal: Add Dutch (nl) as a complete language for everything already translatable: the desktop catalogue, system emails, voucher PDFs, public page texts and the driver app. Split the desktop catalogue into one file per area so later batches can add keys in parallel without colliding, and make i18n-check require complete nl.
why: Owner decision 2026-10-21: a Dutch interface is in scope ('we need to be ready'). R210/R211 built en/hi/ar with a single catalogue file per language, so every batch that adds strings collides on one JSON file; this wave has 20+ batches adding strings. Design: docs/readiness/TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17.

create: desktop/src/messages/en/*.json (one file per top-level namespace, moved from en.json)

steps: Move every key of messages/en.json, hi.json and ar.json into messages/<lang>/<namespace>.json, where namespace is the first dot segment of the key (nav, common, status, leads, contacts, invoices, settings, dashboard, calendar, reports, tasks, fleet, suppliers, vouchers, validation, actions, messages, itineraries, shell, ui, auth, brand, softphone, usage). Keys and values are unchanged (a script may do the move; check the key count is identical before and after).
messages/index.ts imports every file statically and exports one flat Catalogue per language; lib/i18n.ts imports from it.

Pre-create (as {}) and register in index.ts, for all four languages, the namespace files the rest of this wave writes into, so later batches only ever edit their own JSON files and never index.ts: departures, tours, groupTours, booking, trip, extras, coachTrips, payments, quotes, chatbot, pipeline, ageBands, margin, calling, departureMessages, banks, followUps, travellers, visa, documents, rateCards, creditNotes, debitNotes, marketing, campaigns, communication, ai, assistant, import, onboarding, help, notifications, accounts, bookmarks, publicPages, inbox (skip any that already exist). A key's file is its first dot segment; i18n-check fails a key placed in the wrong file.
A desktop vitest asserts the merged en catalogue has exactly the keys it had before the split (snapshot of the key list).
Locale type and LANGUAGES gain { code: 'nl', label: 'Nederlands', dir: 'ltr', enabled: true }.

messages/nl/*.json: a machine translation of every English key, placeholders kept exactly ({name}, {count} ...). Plural or gendered phrasing follows the existing catalogue conventions (no ICU plurals are introduced).
Regional settings offer agency locales nl-NL and en-NL if lib/locale-options.ts lacks them (formatting stays on lib/locale.ts, independent of the interface language).

docs/i18n/NL-REVIEW.md: says the nl strings are machine-made, explains how to review and mark a file reviewed, and points at docs/i18n/nl-review/*.md; docs/i18n/nl-review/foundation.md lists this batch's namespace files with 'needs native review'. Each later batch adds its own docs/i18n/nl-review/<batch>.md (never edits another batch's file), so parallel batches do not collide.

items.what: i18n-check enforces complete nl and reads its scope from files
steps: Read the split catalogues.
COMPLETE_LANGUAGES = ['en', 'nl']: fail when an nl key is missing, extra, or has different {placeholders} than English; hi and ar stay partial (fallback) as today.
SCOPE comes from desktop/scripts/i18n-scope/*.json (each an array of paths relative to desktop/); move today's SCOPE list into i18n-scope/core.json unchanged. Later batches add their own scope file.
Keep the existing exit codes and --json output; update i18n-check.test.ts for the new rules.
backend/src/i18n: a small typed catalogue (en, nl; other languages fall back to en) and t(lang, key, vars).

System emails in services/mail/templates.ts (invitation, password reset, login code, two-factor, welcome, and any other platform_system template there) render in the recipient user's users.language when it is en or nl, else the agency setting default_language, else en. Subjects too.
Voucher PDF labels (routes/vouchers.ts PDF section) come from the catalogue by the voucher's language column; nl added to the voucher language options the API accepts.
routes/public.ts unsubscribe page and quotation error messages use the agency default language.
users.ts and settings.ts accept 'nl' for users.language and default_language (validation lists).
seed-tenant.ts: where system message templates are seeded, seed the agency language's text when nl (add nl versions next to the English ones).

items.what: Driver app in Dutch, agency defaults instead of India
steps: lib/l10n/intl_nl.arb with every key of intl_en.arb; nl in supportedLocales; regenerate with flutter gen-l10n (x86 PowerShell).

driver_auth_repository.dart: normalizePhone gets the agency's dial code (from the agency lookup the app already stores) instead of the '+91' default; phone.dart's default parameter is removed so callers must pass it.

money.dart and packages/shared defaults: the agency currency from storage, else the server value; the 'INR' literals in app_constants.defaultCurrency and the lead/itinerary model defaults become the server-provided currency (keep model fields nullable-safe; regenerate freezed/json code).
Tests: nl_locale_test.dart renders the trips screen in nl; a login test with an NL agency turns '0612345678' into '+31612345678' and '06 1234 5678' the same.
e2e/i18n-nl.spec.ts: switch the language to Nederlands, open the shell, dashboard, login and the converted shared components; assert no missing-key console warnings and html lang='nl'; switch back.

tests: desktop vitest: split catalogue key snapshot; i18n-check rules (missing nl key fails, placeholder mismatch fails, hi partial passes); language switcher lists Nederlands.

backend/test/i18n-nl.test.ts: invitation and password reset emails in nl for a user with language nl, en otherwise; voucher PDF text contains the Dutch labels for a voucher with language nl (extract text from the PDF bytes or test the label function); unsubscribe page in nl for an agency with default_language nl.
Flutter: nl_locale_test.dart and the NL login normalisation test; existing driver tests stay green.
acceptance: node desktop/scripts/i18n-check.mjs passes with nl complete and fails if one nl key is removed.
No file named desktop/src/messages/<lang>.json remains; all keys load as before (existing tests green).
A Dutch-language user receives Dutch system emails; a voucher with language nl prints Dutch labels.
The driver app runs in Dutch and logs in an NL agency's driver with a national number.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/i18n-nl.spec.ts e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts e2e/rtl.spec.ts e2e/locale.spec.ts e2e/vouchers.spec.ts

x86 PowerShell: "C:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe" -Command "cd C:/Users/Admin/Downloads/pro/CRM/packages/driver_app; flutter gen-l10n; flutter analyze; flutter test; cd ../shared; flutter analyze; flutter test"  (first: tasklist | findstr /i "java.exe dart.exe flutter" must show no build in progress)
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere (code, seeds, fixtures, strings, docs).
Every new or moved string keeps its key; nl must be complete for every key that exists after this batch.
Desktop: desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md; RTL-safe classes (ms-/me-/ps-/pe-); money and dates only through lib/format.ts and lib/dates.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, docs/readiness/TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md section 0, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; unlink junctions before git worktree remove).
Translations are machine-made by the executor; mark them in docs/i18n/NL-REVIEW.md. Do not translate brand names, placeholders or keys.

Every later batch of this wave writes en and nl keys into the pre-created desktop/src/messages/<lang>/<namespace>.json files; a batch that truly needs a new namespace adds it to index.ts and says so in its report (only one batch of a parallel pair may do that).
goLiveVerify: A native Dutch speaker reviews the files listed in docs/i18n/NL-REVIEW.md before a Dutch agency goes live.
